_comment: The (resource, operation) pairs the DEPLOYED @nonagentic/n8n-nodes-coding node accepts.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. seed-it-procedures.ts writes the live agentic procedures that the AA
conveyor executes, and a step's `parameters.resource` + `parameters.operation` are handed to
that n8n node verbatim. When the coding API was regenerated with orval the whole
container -> workspace rename landed in the node, and this seeder was never updated. The
result was silent and total: `createContainer` does not exist in the node, so the dispatch
died locally and coding-containers logged ZERO requests -- every project_setup card scored
0/3 steps, and 29 execInContainer steps across the development_* ladder were dead the same
way.
It stayed broken because the seed Job re-runs daily (ttlSecondsAfterFinished 86400 + a Flux
Kustomization with prune/force on a 5-minute interval recreates it), so a hand fix to the
live procedure is reverted within 24h. Measured: procedure project_setup.doing.action
versions 213-218 and 220 all carry the dead names; v219, a hand fix at 08:06 on 2026-08-25,
was reverted by v220 at 17:40 the same day.
HOW THIS WAS MEASURED (2026-08-25), and how to regenerate it. Read the node's compiled
resource modules INSIDE the running n8n pod -- not a local clone, which can be stale:
kubectl -n n8n exec deploy/n8n -c n8n -- ls \
/opt/n8n-custom-nodes/node_modules/@nonagentic/n8n-nodes-coding/dist/nodes/Coding/resources/
and for each *.resource.js collect its displayOptions `resource` values and its operation
option `value`s. Cross-check an op against the service's own openapi.json operationId
(create_workspace <-> createWorkspace).
ALWAYS run a POSITIVE CONTROL when validating. The first probe written for this reported
EVERY pair dead, including ones already measured present -- its extraction silently matched
nothing. A probe that cannot ask its question must never get to answer it.
